title: Heartbeat
description: Periodic liveness and health sample from a kiosk. Published retained at QoS 0, so the last one always describes the current state.

modelVersion.description: Version string of the active models partition, from nvs:model/version.

heapMinFreeBytes.description: Low-water mark since boot; a falling value across heartbeats means a leak.

pendingUplinkCount.description: Attendance records written to flash but not yet acknowledged by the broker.

activeSlot.description: Which models partition is in use, models_0 or models_1.

rosterVersion.description: Roster generation this device has applied. A number behind the server's own is how a kiosk that missed a deletion while offline gets told about it.

embeddingVersion.description: Recognition model this device compares with. A template pushed under any other value is refused, so this is the string a server has to match.

onTrial.description: True while the running firmware has not confirmed itself after an update: any reboot now returns to the previous build. Absent from builds before it was added.
